non_idle_rule: After every result or interruption, immediately analyze, log, and launch the next experiment. The watchdog recovers only declared queued workers. When the queue is empty, the primary Codex process must plan and enqueue the next experiments. Wait only for an active process, active Codex planning, or required external operation. Stop only on exact top-level STOP.
current_hypothesis: The 0.75 and 0.25 smoothing blend reached aggregate test macro F1 0.555625, below the 0.556214 50/50 leader, so the simple weight sweep is closed. The strongest encoder clean-validation runs still underrepresent the direct class, and the 50 rejected-direct-example probe improved clean-validation macro F1 but lacked transfer. A bounded class-balanced auxiliary-data probe adds 100 available SFT examples per class to test whether balanced supervision improves the direct-class representation without changing the seed.
